poin.isi: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on September 30. It is built for long, complex work: coding, legal and finance knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense. For now it is open only to a select group of cyber defenders.

The strongest model releases now arrive in careful, staged rollouts. The newest model is not automatically ready for everyday business — and brochure numbers are proven in internal tests, not in real work.
Do not chase the newest model. Choose one that is stable, fits your daily work, and fits your budget. What decides the outcome is not the model's name, but how it is used.

headline: THE STRONGEST MODEL,
STILL OUT OF REACH
headline_caption: Gemini 4 Argon: more capable, released in stages.
subjudul: Google ships Gemini 4 Argon (Sep 30) for long-horizon work — open only to selected cyber defenders.
